# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 12 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale volumes hit 2026 high in July, but prices soften** - July recorded 2,660 resale transactions — the highest monthly volume so far in 2026 — while the resale price index continued to ease, sitting 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

## En Bloc & Collective Sales

- **Parliament introduces lower consent threshold for older developments** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner-consent requirement for collective sales of developments aged 40–59 years from 80% to 70%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/proposed-en-bloc-consent-thresholds/)

- **Lakeside Towers launches third en bloc attempt at $350 million** - The 45-year-old condominium has relaunched its collective sale tender at the same $350 million reserve price after unsuccessful attempts in 2018, 2022, and 2023. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-45-year-old-condo-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-350-million-price-tag/)

## New Launches & Market Trends

- **Bukit Sembawang launches Phase 10 of Luxus Hills in Seletar Hills** - The new phase offers five-bedroom terrace houses on 999-year leasehold tenure, featuring private lifts, rooftop solar panels, and EV-ready provisions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/toured-a-new-collection-of-999-year-landed-homes-seletar/)

- **Debate over agent priority access at new condo launches** - A report questions whether property agents receiving priority access at new condo launches — at prices referenced around $2,700 psf — is fair to homebuyers, and raises the idea of a balloting approach instead. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/should-property-agents-get-first-dibs-at-new-condo-launches-there-may-be-a-fairer-way/)
